scenes.title: 2001 UC San Diego 'Ishihara-in-Reverse': Spotting the Hidden Triangle of '2's Inside a Sea of Black '5's in One Second
scenes.era: 2001, Center for Brain and Cognition, UC San Diego

layout.description: Sunlit California psychology laboratory featuring a crisp white tabletop tachistoscope / easel card holder displaying a large square grid of block-digital black **5**s with six block-digital black **2**s secretly forming an upright triangle at center, beside a 1.0-second shutter timer and a transparent color-overlay reveal sheet showing how the red '2' triangle leaps out to a synesthete.

positions.who: V. S. Ramachandran & Edward Hubbard (mannequins in 2001 collared shirts and blazer)
positions.where: flashing the all-black '2s-in-5s' matrix card for 1.0 second and holding the transparent red-on-green teaching overlay beside it for comparison
leaning in squinting item-by-item at the identical black block digits as the 1-second timer expires at 59%
tracing an unmistakable upright triangle in mid-air within half a second with an 81% hit smile!

props.name: all-black digital '2s hidden in 5s' matrix card
props.period_detail: block-font mirrored 2s and 5s that foil ordinary fast vision

props.name: 1.0-second flash timer & 'Control 59% vs Synesthete 81%' bar plaque
props.period_detail: prevents slow memorization tricks from faking performance
props.physical_behavior: separates real sensory pop-out from memory

props.name: transparent ruby-red / emerald-green educational reveal sheet
props.period_detail: placed aside to show the viewer why six '2's pop into an instant triangle when V4 fires
props.physical_behavior: makes invisible subjective perception crystal clear

actions.verb_sequence: reveals the all-black 2s-and-5s card for 1.0 second -> Control Subject squints still hunting row 1 -> Synesthete Subject immediately traces the central triangle with index finger
slides the teaching overlay forward demonstrating how fusiform-V4 color grouping creates instant pop-out

reactions.reaction: leans back amazed once the hidden triangle of '2's is pointed out
smiles relieved to have objective scientific proof after years of disbelief

scenes.wardrobe: 2001 California academic attire: tailored dark blazer over open-collar dress shirt; casual button-downs.
scenes.recognition_hook: Stare at forty black '5's for one second and miss the hidden shape — unless your brain automatically paints every '2' ruby red!

key_visual.description: a 2001 UCSD lab table displaying an all-black grid of digital 5s hiding a triangle of 2s beside a 1-second timer as a synesthete traces the hidden triangle immediately while a control subject squints

scenes.title: 10-Year Consistency Check & Fisher-Price Fridge Magnets

layout.description: Bright table comparing a 1970s colored plastic alphabet-magnet tray ('A=Red, B=Orange, C=Yellow') beside a 10-year color-swatch retest chart (>92% match).

positions.where: matching 100 color swatches identically a decade apart — and spotting the childhood magnet influence in a subset of cohorts

props.name: 100-swatch consistency chart (>90%) & colorful alphabet tile tray
props.period_detail: shows genetic cross-wiring shaped by early literacy exposure

actions.verb_sequence: picks the exact same Pantone shade for 'R' and '7' years later without hesitation

reactions.reaction: notes how genes + childhood learning co-sculpt cortex

scenes.recognition_hook: Ask a faker to re-guess 100 fake letter colors a year later and they drop to 35%; ask a synesthete ten years later and they nail over 90%.

scenes.title: Bouba vs Kiki: Every Human Brain's Shared Mini-Synesthesia

layout.description: Sunlit lectern holding two crisp white cutout plaques — one rounded cloud-amoeba shape and one sharp jagged star shape.

positions.where: holding up the rounded plaque and jagged plaque asking 'Which one is Bouba and which is Kiki?'
pointing unanimously (95%+) to the round cloud for 'Bouba' and jagged star for 'Kiki'

props.name: rounded 'Bouba' & jagged 'Kiki' white plaques
props.period_detail: 95%+ cross-cultural agreement linking lip/sound contour to visual shape
props.physical_behavior: bridges rare synesthesia to universal human language evolution

actions.verb_sequence: lifts both shapes -> entire row points identically on the count of three

reactions.reaction: laughs realizing every human cross-maps sound and shape

scenes.recognition_hook: Think you have zero synesthesia? 95% of humans on Earth agree which shape is 'Bouba' and which is 'Kiki' in half a second.
